method: Direct inspection of saved original PNG via view_image(detail=original), compared with supplied portrait and frozen test-case before receiving the arm pixel verdict.

gates.evidence: The exterior van, camera display and notebook photo repeat a clear diagonal red marker. However, the projected lens direction runs upward/right while the pictured van sits upper/left of the lens; the optical route to that vehicle is not established. Target-to-record correspondence alone does not satisfy the whole physical camera chain.
A coherently owned pencil touches the open notebook beside a van photo with the same marker. Visible notes and marks do not prove real chronology or historical recording.

Microphone is held at the mouth and a coiled lead descends across the front. A belt radio is visible at the right hip, but the cord continues below/behind the lap and its radio connector is not continuously traceable. Possession of both endpoints does not prove connection.
Short dark bob, wispy fringe, dark eyes and soft facial contours are assessable and follow the supplied portrait broadly; no identity or age claim.
Seated support, two tool-holding hands and pencil contact are plausible. The required optical route and complete radio cable route remain unresolved.

new_source_pixel_qualification: NOT_TESTED: new analysis-comparison candidate was exposed but not adopted.
artistic_observation: A coherent observational scene with an unusually clear repeated vehicle marker, wet rail-yard context and readable note-taking. Strong contextual legibility does not repair the missing physical routes.
